items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I met, uh, Piran, the violinist

ctx.x: Were there any New Orleans fellows by any chance, you think, in that band? Or do you remember the first New Orleans musicians you met or heard up here?

Uh, oh, many, many in Chicago. But, uh, I would like to make the statement that, uh, before I came to Chicago, I met, uh, Piran, the violinist, and Clarence William, the pianist. They made a tour to Memphis, from New Orleans to Memphis. And they were pushing a song that they wrote called, uh, I Can Beat You Doing What You're Doing Me. And they made a tour with a handy band as a team from New Orleans. Clarence sang and played the piano. Piran played the violin. And they were playing the violin, and what a violin…
When did you first hear or meet T.O.?
